BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, eusebōs is the word for godly. In 2 Timothy 3:12, the text says "and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, eusebōs, does its job quietly — godly — and I leave it at that.
